name: codex
description: Use OpenAI Codex through its CLI and app-server, with realtime task orchestration, memory search, review handoffs, coding contracts, and the Codex Voice Apple Watch companion.

interface.shortDescription: Codex runtime, memory search, reviews, and Watch voice
interface.longDescription: Work with OpenAI Codex as a coding agent and developer product: coordinate realtime conversations with sub-agent-first research and substantial implementation, explicitly requested separate tasks, and a user-controlled one-topic priority queue; use its CLI and app-server runtime; search canonical Codex memory from Claude Code; run Codex reviews; preserve the prompting and result-handling contracts around those runs; and securely pair the Codex Voice iPhone and Apple Watch companion with the Mac bridge. Desktop-host internals and patching live in the separate ChatGPT app plugin because the products now share one bundle.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this Codex CLI or app-server behavior
Review my current changes with Codex
Set up Codex as a Claude Code review companion
Set up Codex Voice for this workspace and show the pairing QR
